mapper.select: SELECT ( CASE when job = 1 then 'Cohort Lead' when job = 2 then 'Instructor' when job = 3 then 'Student Affairs Manager' when job = 4 then 'Curriculum Manager' when job = 5 then 'Advisor' when job IS NULL then 'Unassigned Role' else 'Other' end ) AS job, count( 0 ) AS count FROM emp GROUP BY job ORDER BY count ASC, job ASC
SELECT ( CASE gender when 1 then 'Male' when 2 then 'Female' else 'Other' end ) AS name, count( 0 ) AS value FROM emp GROUP BY gender ORDER BY value ASC, gender ASC
